ColumnStats.description:
Computed over every row returned, not the preview: a total the preview
cannot show is still a number the answer may state, and the judge checks it
against this. When the source capped the result, `provenance.truncation`
says so and the stats describe the rows that came back.

Numeric columns fill min/max/sum; text columns fill `distinct` (first
DISTINCT_MAX_VALUES, in row order) and `distinct_count`.

Refusal.description:
Why an agent turn ended without an answer — the `__refusal` stream frame.

`message` and `next_action` default to the code's entry in USER_MESSAGE_VI /
NEXT_ACTION; a producer narrows them only when it knows a more precise case
of the same code (an agent that was never published is AGENT_CONFIG_ERROR,
but retrying will not publish it). `detail_id` finds the turn's trace.
